overviewHtml:
Cost owners want early notice when spend approaches the monthly budget, without checking reports. If spend stays below the threshold, nothing is sent.

What you get

  • Month-to-date costs from the Account Management API by environment and capability
  • Spend calculated as a percentage of your MONTHLY_BUDGET
  • Email with cost breakdown when the threshold is met
  • Threshold set on the workflow step condition
prereqsHtml:
• An OAuth client with account-uac-read scope
  • A Credential Vault entry named DPS Budget Tracker OAuth
  • The dynatrace.email connector enabled in your environment

See SETUP.md for step-by-step instructions.
getStartedHtml:
You need an OAuth client, a Credential Vault entry and the email connector.

  1. Create the OAuth client and store it in Credential Vault
  2. Import the workflow and set your monthly budget
  3. Set the threshold and recipients

Full setup instructions are in the README.
